items.title: VRTX Down as FDA Extends Review Timeline for Povetacicept BLA
items.summary: Vertex shares fell 7.3% after the FDA extended its povetacicept review by three months, delaying a key approval decision to February 2027.

items.title: Vera Therapeutics Stock Soars After Hours as the FDA Delays Vertex’s Rival Kidney Drug
items.summary: A regulatory delay handed Vera Therapeutics a three-month head start on a $143 billion rival, and traders rushed in. But the bigger threat to Vera's drug has nothing to do with the calendar, and one February deadline could undo the rally.
